definitions.explanation: Losing a physical item, especially important documents, valuables, or personal belongings. More formal than simply saying something was lost.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛失|ふんしつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紛失|ふんしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}た→届け出る：05910_todokederu⟧。
examples.english: I reported the loss of my key.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛失|ふんしつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{速|すみ}やか→速やか：15283_sumiyaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}して→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you lose any documents, please contact the person in charge immediately.

notes:
{紛失|ふんしつ} is a formal noun that also functions as a suru-verb ({紛失|ふんしつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). It is the standard formal word for losing a physical item.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛失|ふんしつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to lose one's passport)
- ⟦{紛失届|ふんしつとどけ}→紛失届：20685_funshitsutodoke⟧ (a lost item report)
- {紛失|ふんしつ}{届|とどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to file a lost item report)
- {紛失|ふんしつ}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (loss prevention)

RELATED WORDS:
なくす is the everyday word for losing something. {紛失|ふんしつ} is more formal and is used in official reports, announcements, and business contexts. {遺失|いしつ} (loss of property) is even more formal and is used in legal contexts — ⟦{遺失物|いしつぶつ}→遺失物：15652_ishitsubutsu⟧ means "lost property."
